prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW aquarium game asset, not the reference character. Match the REFERENCE illustration's friendly CARTOON visual language: chunky rounded simplified silhouette, strong clean dark brown outlines, bold appealing shapes, expressive oversized glossy eyes if the animal has eyes, warm layered hand-painted cel shading and broad clean highlights. Cute stylized mobile-game character, NOT scientific drawing, realistic rendering, fine anatomical filaments or washed-out watercolor. No otter traits or otter accessories. Subject: A slender blue RIBBON EEL with a narrow yellow dorsal ribbon fin and yellow snout, gently S-curved long body, compact silhouette, friendly glossy eye. No extra ribbons. Side profile facing LEFT throughout. COMMON grade: especially round, lovable and strongly cartoonified, natural recognizable base colors; shrimp must be plump and simplified with BIG friendly eyes and short thick readable legs rather than realistic thin anatomy.  OUTPUT a square 2x2 ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET: four equal square cells edge-to-edge, exactly ONE same character in each cell. Use thumbnail reference as exact character identity, same size and position relative to each cell. Four subtle tail and fin swimming phases. Each creature occupies central 68% of its cell with generous padding, no body turning or translation. Grid must have no visible lines. True transparent background, no ground, scenery, bubbles, cast shadow, words, watermarks, grid, labels.
